# okstatus Provider

Manage OKStatus (okstatus.eu) monitors, monitor groups, incidents, status pages, alert channels and maintenances as code.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    okstatus = {
      source = "clearcloud-fr/okstatus"
    }
  }
}

provider "okstatus" {
  # api_key can also come from the OKSTATUS_API_KEY environment variable.
  # api_key = "oks_live_..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) OKStatus API key (`oks_live_...`, from Dashboard → Settings → API Keys, Max plan required). Falls back to the `OKSTATUS_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) OKStatus API base URL. Defaults to `https://api.okstatus.eu/api/v1`.
